method_note: P(score) from real per-player goal rates (every NHL boxscore since 2024-25, EWMA + position prior) x the opposing goalie's goals-allowed factor (desk's confirmed / expected / projected starter, shrunk GSAA), negative binomial fitted on last season. Candidates: scorers >= 0.25 goals/game. STRONG_YES 60-72%, STRONG_NO when P(score) <= 20%. Replaced hand-typed tables 2026-11-02.
